act.containerSet: Container set to %s. The mod will stay still and take the lecterns out of it after each break (it must be within %d blocks of where you stand).
act.noSupport: The lectern has no neighbouring block to click when re-placing it.
act.notContainer: That block (%s) is not a chest (any kind, copper included), barrel, hopper, dropper, dispenser or shulker box.
act.notLectern: That block is not a lectern.
cal.ambiguous: %d possible positions, needs more consecutive opens
cal.daytime: daytime: villagers generate trades on their own, not calibrating (use night)
cal.noData: VTP has no data for this villager
cal.noMatch: no matching round in VTP's search window (check /vtp seed, or raise /vtp maxrerolls)
cal.rejected: VTP rejected the confirmation (state changed), retrying
cmd.containerAt: Lecterns are taken from the container at %s.
cmd.containerCleared: Container cleared: broken lecterns are picked up from the floor again.
cmd.containerNone: No container set: broken lecterns are picked up from the floor. Look at the chest/hopper/barrel that receives them and run /vprng container set.
cmd.highlightOn: Block highlighting on (green = usable, red = invalid).
cmd.hudMoved: HUD moved to %d, %d (GUI pixels from the top left).
cmd.logsOff: Chat log messages off (replies to your commands still show).
cmd.statusVjf: Villager Job Fix: %s, last check: %s (use /vprng vjf to re-check)
cmd.vjfDisabled: Villager Job Fix disabled in the config.
cmd.vjfEnabled: Villager Job Fix enabled in the config.
cmd.vjfNote: Note: the data pack was not detected earlier (%s). Sending anyway.
cmd.vjfServer: Villager Job Fix on this server: %s
container.cannotOpen: could not open the container at %s (not a chest/barrel/hopper, blocked, or no permission?)
container.unreachable: the container at %s is out of reach
ctl.calibrated: VTP sequence calibrated automatically at round %d (%s).
ctl.cellUnreachable: Cell %s is out of reach. Stand closer to the pool.
ctl.containerUnreachable: The lectern container at %s is out of reach. Stand closer.
ctl.found: FOUND %s after %d opens / %d cycles. The villager is kept; its trade screen is open.
ctl.keptJob: Some villagers kept their job (another lectern nearby?); ignoring them from now on.
ctl.maxCycles: Reached the configured maximum of %d cycles.
ctl.needStack: Need at least %d lecterns in that stack (placed ones are picked up into the same stack, which must never run empty). Have %d.
ctl.noTargets: No VTP targets. Add one with /vtp target <enchantment> <level> (or the VTP settings screen).
ctl.noTool: Breaking %s needs the correct tool (for example a pickaxe) in the hotbar: by hand the block would be destroyed without dropping its item. Put the tool in your hotbar and try again.
ctl.outOfWindow: No target within VTP's search window (%s): burning rounds until one comes into range.
ctl.pausedLog: Paused: %s (/vprng resume, or press the key, to continue)
ctl.poolEmpty: The pool is empty. Look at a lectern and run /vprng pool add (or /vprng pool scan).
ctl.putLecterns: Put a stack of lecterns in your off hand or hotbar (the tool is chosen automatically).
ctl.started: Started: pool of %d, verifying every open.
ctl.vjfChecking: Villager Job Fix: on (checking the server).
ctl.vjfMissing: Villager Job Fix is enabled in the config but %s. Continuing without it.
ctl.workWarn: Warning: it is villager work time; predictions may drift.
ctl.workWarnStart: Warning: it is villager work time, so villagers may generate trades by themselves.
hud.edit.help: Drag a panel to move it · drag its right/bottom edge or corner to resize · arrows move 1 px (Shift: 8 px, Ctrl: resize) · × hides · ESC finishes
hud.edit.resetTip: Puts every panel back in the automatic position
hud.edit.title: Edit HUD
pause.blocked: a %s has been standing in the cell at %s for %d s, so a lectern cannot be placed there. Wall off the space behind the lectern (or box the villager in) and resume
pause.breakSlow: breaking the lectern takes too long (use an axe, ideally enchanted)
pause.cannotPlace: cannot place a lectern at %s (%s; cell holds %s, support is %s, sneaking %s, using %s with %s)
pause.containerClosed: the container screen was closed manually
pause.dropsBlocked: could not reach the dropped lecterns (blocked path?)
pause.dropsOut: dropped lecterns are out of pickup range (step closer or enable autoCollect)
pause.homeBlocked: could not get back to the starting spot (blocked path?) - step there manually and resume
pause.homeStart: could not walk back to the starting position
pause.lecternUnreachable: lectern at %s is out of reach
pause.lecternsNotInHand: the %d lecterns in your inventory are not in the off hand or hotbar
pause.missing: lecterns missing: have %d, expected %d and none lying on the ground nearby. If hoppers collect them, register the chest with /vprng container set
pause.noBuild: your game mode does not allow building
pause.noClaim: no villager claimed a lectern (jobless villager within reach? cell next to it?)
pause.noLecternLeft: no lectern left in the inventory (expected %d)
pause.noLecternLeftAny: no lectern left in the inventory
pause.noLecternsAnywhere: no lecterns in the inventory or in the container at %s
pause.noSupport: there is no block under/behind the cell at %s to click when placing the lectern
pause.notInContainer: the lecterns did not reach the container at %s (have %d, expected %d); check that every cell's drop lands on a hopper
pause.occupied: the cell at %s is occupied by %s; remove it, or run /vprng pool clear and register the lecterns again
pause.overlapNoWalk: your hitbox overlaps the cell at %s; move so you stand clear of the cells and resume
pause.overlapStep: your hitbox overlaps the cell at %s; step back and resume
pause.ownScreen: the Villager Trading Reroller window was opened
pause.placeRefused: the server keeps refusing the lectern placement (check cell positions / permissions)
pause.spectator: you are in spectator mode (cannot place, break or interact)
pause.workTime: villager work time (they generate trades on their own)
st.collecting: Taking lecterns out of the container
st.vjf: Forcing jobs via Villager Job Fix (%s)
st.waitCell: Waiting for a %s to leave cell %s
st.waitClaim: Waiting for villagers to claim lecterns
st.waitReset: Waiting for villagers to lose their job
tip.start: Closes the window and starts (an open window pauses a run)
vjf.noReply: no reply from the server (try again)
vjf.noTrigger: the server offers no vjf_single/vjf_multiple trigger to you (data pack missing, not loaded, or its triggers are not enabled for your player)
win.container.notSet: not set — picking up from the floor
win.container.title: Recovery container
win.containerRemoved: Container removed: picking up from the floor.
win.footer: Window: %s · %s starts/pauses · opening this window pauses a run
win.hlAllTip: Turns every outline on/off; each block below also has its own switch
win.language.label: Mod language
win.noBlocksHint: Look at a lectern and use '+ Looked at', or 'Scan'.
win.opt.calibrateTip: Aligns VTP's position with the observed offers (night only)
win.opt.chatLogsTip: Pauses, calibration and warnings; the HUD shows the same (off by default)
win.opt.collect: Walk to pick up lecterns from the floor
win.opt.collectTip: Used when no container is registered
win.opt.highlightTip: Green = ready · red = invalid (with the reason)
win.opt.sneakTip: Needed when the support is a hopper/chest
win.opt.sound: Sound when the book is found
win.opt.unfocused: Keep running when the window loses focus
win.opt.unfocusedTip: Turns off 'pause on lost focus' while running
win.tip.check: Asks the server whether the data pack exists
win.tip.clearAll: Removes every block from the pool (click twice)
win.tip.dayGuard: OFF, WARN (warns) or BLOCK (pauses by day)
win.tip.deleteBlock: Removes this block from the pool
win.tip.editHud: Drag the panels wherever you like
win.tip.hlBlock: Shows or hides the outline of this block only
win.tip.hlContainer: Shows or hides the container's outline
win.tip.language: Language of this mod only (Auto follows the game's language)
win.tip.looked: Closes the window, adds the lectern you are looking at and reopens it
win.tip.setContainer: Closes the window and uses the chest/hopper you are looking at
win.tip.viewBlock: Closes the window and highlights this block in the world
win.tip.viewContainer: Highlights the container in the world
win.vjf.use: Use the Villager Job Fix data pack
win.vjf.useTip: Makes villagers take the workstations right away with /trigger vjf_single|vjf_multiple
